latest_release.name: v5.53.0
latest_release.body:
## New Features
* Add Stream based Packet Addr for UDP Connections  in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3774
* rrpit: compact session, async send, session recovery  in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3787
* Add socks5ify engineering command  in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3776

## Chores
* Fix lint failure by removing redundant embedded field selectors in packetaddr wrapper in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3775
* bump actions/setup-go from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3778
* Chore: bump actions/stale from 10 to 11 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3784
* Chore: bump redhat-actions/push-to-registry from 2 to 3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3786
* Chore: bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.81.1 to 1.82.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3783
* Chore: bump redhat-actions/podman-login from 1 to 2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3781
* Chore: bump github.com/quic-go/quic-go from 0.59.1 to 0.61.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3770
* Chore: bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.82.1 to 1.83.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3771
* Chore: bump github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 from 5.3.0 to 5.3.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3769
* Chore: bump github.com/pires/go-proxyproto from 0.12.0 to 0.15.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3772
* Chore: bump github.com/go-playground/validator/v10 from 10.30.2 to 10.30.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/pull/3739

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/v2fly/v2ray-core/compare/v5.52.0...v5.53.0
